finding.summary: When gres_config != "4": The environment variable NNSMITH_GRES selects the reshape grouping strategy: "5" = one group (flatten), "3" = min(src_len, dst_len) groups, "4" (default) = random number of groups weighted by 2**i. Any other value raises ValueError, rejecting the model. The chosen grouping changes the generated reshape constraints and hence the accepted graphs. (nnsmith/abstract/op.py:1...
